payload.instruction: Label independent fitness-chat utterances by returning a JSON object with 'intent' and 'entities'. Intent must be one of: generate_plan, find_exercise, get_nutrition_info, log_feeling, general_chat, out_of_scope. Extract entities (exercise, body_part, equipment, goal, level, duration, food, nutrient) as lowercase strings or USDA canonical names where applicable, ensuring negation is captured and no profile context is inherited. Output exactly one JSON object with no additional fields or reasoning.
